action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
curl -s -D m_sso_h.txt --max-time 10 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"type":"m.login.sso","sso_idp":"oidc"}' \
  http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/login -o m_sso_body.html
grep -iE '^HTTP|^location' m_sso_h.txt | head -3

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap\ncurl -s -D m_sso_h.txt --max-time 10 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{\"type\":\"m.login.sso\",\"sso_idp\":\"oidc\"}' \\\n  http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/login -o m_sso_body.html\ngrep -iE '^HTTP|^location' m_sso_h.txt | head -3", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Start Matrix SSO login as oidc idp"}
